name: WoW Addon Translator
description: Scans WoW AddOn repositories (AceLocale-3.0 & JSON/ns.L), validates placeholders and color codes, supports optional AI suggestions with a WoW glossary, and opens 1-click GitHub PRs.
author: gOOvER

settingsSchema.label: Optional AI Engine
settingsSchema.description: Optional: AI provider for translation suggestions. Without an API key the editor works 100% manually.

settingsSchema.label: AI Model (optional)
settingsSchema.description: Leave empty for default model (gemini-2.5-flash / gpt-4o-mini).

settingsSchema.label: OpenAI-Compatible Base URL (optional)
settingsSchema.description: Only needed for custom endpoints like Ollama (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1).
